translations.en: You decide to head for the lowest level of Watering.
Welcome back!
Did you find the pink Vorpal Bunny?
With eyes shining and hands clasping eagerly,
@7rTanya@0r waits for your answer.
You hold out the Vorpal Bunny you captured.
Yaaay! Thank you!
It's so cute! We're going to be together forever!
Thank you!
It isn't much, but here's your reward!
From @7rTanya@0r, you received a reward of @3r30,000 G@0r.
Thank you so much!
If I need anything else, I'll ask you again!
Oh, I have to give this little one a name...
How about @7rCuisinart@0r?
Isn't that a bit hard to say?
When you point this out, @7rTanya@0r cheerfully
starts thinking it over.
In any case, seeing her this happy
makes the work worthwhile.
Please find it soon!
If you find the pink Vorpal Bunny,
I'm sure we'll be friends!
Does @7rTanya@0r realize
that a Vorpal Bunny is an extremely vicious
killer rabbit?
The thought leaves you a little uneasy,
but on the other hand, if anyone could befriend one, @7rTanya@0r could...
You cannot help feeling that way, too.
Huh? Have you decided to look
for the pink Vorpal Bunny for me? Have you?
I'd be really happy if you have!
Well? Will you do it? Will you?
When you agree to accept,
@7rTanya@0r jumps for joy.
Thank you!
You really, really have to bring it back!
Promise!
The pink Vorpal Bunny is rumored to roam @6rBahelmeja@0r,
appearing in many different places.
Unless you are prepared to search every district,
you will probably have trouble finding it.
There's a mushroom Vorpal Bunnies love,
called @3rKigashira@0r. I heard that if you have one,
even the pink bunny will come right up to you.
@3rKigashira@0r? Come to think of it, you remember @3rKigashira Mushroom@0r
being said to intoxicate Vorpal Bunnies,
according to a rumor you heard somewhere.
I heard the @3rKigashira Mushroom@0r grows all over @6rBahelmeja@0r.
So first, please explore @6rBahelmeja@0r
and look for a @3rKigashira Mushroom@0r.
For now, you should search the ruins of @6rBahelmeja@0r
for a @3rKigashira Mushroom@0r.
When you refuse, @7rTanya@0r purses her lips
and arches her eyebrows sadly.
Awww! You really won't look for it?
You can't? Awwww!
Perhaps realizing that sulking will not help,
@7rTanya@0r lets her shoulders droop.
All right. I shouldn't force you to do it.
If you change your mind, come and talk to me anytime.
@7rTanya's@0r counting on you, and I'll keep waiting!
With that, @7rTanya@0r gives you a bright smile.
I want you to find a bunny for me!
@7rTanya's@0r sudden announcement leaves you blinking in confusion.
There's a pink bunny somewhere in @6rBahelmeja@0r.
I want you to find it for me.
I'll pay you properly, so please bring it here!
You have heard the rumor yourself.
In the ruins of @6rBahelmeja@0r, a pink Vorpal Bunny
was supposedly sighted.
You thought that @7rTanya@0r, with her love of cute things, would leap at the news,
and she has done exactly as you expected.
Apparently, it's a pink Vorpal Bunny.
But I really, really want to meet it!
Please find it and bring it here!
@7rTanya@0r says this,
then stares at you as though, if you refuse,
she might stuff you into a Vorpal Bunny costume herself.
You received a @3rMagic Guard@0r.

context: Tanya receives the pink Vorpal Bunny and later requests its capture; Kigashira Mushroom is bait.
decisions: Control tokens remain on their source rows and in their original sequence. Genuine sentence continuations retain row boundaries; other omitted subjects are restored from scene context. Unknown historical warrior gender stays neutral. Item names follow the shared glossary; established imported prose and provenance remain intact.
